import re

def grid_after(text, label):
    m=re.search(re.escape(label)+r' \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',text)
    h,w=map(int,m.groups())
    rows=[]
    for line in text[m.end():].splitlines()[:h]:
        vals=list(map(int,line.split()))
        assert len(vals)==w, (len(vals),line)
        rows.append(vals)
    return rows

def predict(g,allowed):
 from collections import Counter
 cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row); marker=min(cnt,key=cnt.get); pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==marker]
 r0=min(r for r,c in pts);c0=min(c for r,c in pts);pts=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts]
 mask=[[0]*(max(c for r,c in pts)+1) for _ in range(max(r for r,c in pts)+1)]
 for r,c in pts:mask[r][c]=1
 # return transforms via enabled index? list ordering each orientation no flip then flip
 sh=transforms(mask)
 if allowed=='id': sh=sh[:1]
 elif allowed=='rot': sh=sh[::2]
 elif allowed=='mirror': sh=sh[1::2]
 out=[row[:] for row in g]; placements=[]
 for s in sh:
  h=max(r for r,c in s)+1;w=max(c for r,c in s)+1
  for r in range(len(g)-h+1):
   for c in range(len(g[0])-w+1):
    if all(g[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in s):
     placements.append((s,r,c))
     for dr,dc in s:out[r+dr][c+dc]=marker
 return out,placements
for i,(x,y) in enumerate(pairs):

program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == marker]
    top = min(r for r, c in points)
    left = min(c for r, c in points)
    points = [(r - top, c - left) for r, c in points]
    height = max(r for r, c in points) + 1
    width = max(c for r, c in points) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(len(grid) - height + 1):
        for c in range(len(grid[0]) - width + 1):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in points):
                for dr, dc in points:
                    out[r + dr][c + dc] = marker
    return out
'''
